question: What ritual effect follows burying a mantra chanted three thousand times on a road?
premises: Chanting is performed three thousand times.
The chanted object is buried on a road.
The result is obstruction of a net.
inference: Burying a mantra chanted three thousand times on a road produces obstruction of a net.
uncertainties: The exact nature of jāla (net/snare) is context-dependent.
plain_english: Having chanted it three thousand times, one should bury it on a road; then there is obstruction of the net.
